issues.where: upper-left cave, lavafall, and ridge across the right background
issues.what: The cave reads as a dim recess with little glowing lip, the lavafall breaks into isolated yellow blobs, and the right bluff becomes a broad rubble slope that fills the central gap. The target has a connected hot descent into the basin, a distinct steep bluff, and more atmospheric space between the landforms.
issues.fix: Define the underlit cave lip, reconnect the descending lava to its runout, and pull back the broad rubble apron so the steep bluff stands apart behind the haze.

issues.where: foreground and midground lava field, from beneath the lead animal to the right edge
issues.what: Pale, deeply ridged slabs and pebbles dominate the floor, with the brightest lava shifted to a broad streak at front left. The target has lower, dark charcoal crust threaded with fine hot seams and active pools continuing from the lead animal's tendrils toward the lower right.
issues.fix: Lower and darken the crust relief, reduce scattered stones, and carry a broken network of narrow orange-yellow fissures and molten pockets across the center and lower-right floor.

issues.where: cave mouth, recessed ceiling, and enclosing far wall
issues.what: The cave is a boxier slot with an almost level lid in a uniformly textured vertical wall. It lacks the broad curved vault and successive curved rock faces that recede into the dark in the target.
issues.fix: Round and open the vault, give the interior layered curved faces that recede into shadow, and break up the vertical wall with more varied natural outcrops.

issues.fix: Restore the broad upper spill and taller stepped falls, define the separate threads dropping over the ledges, and use finer irregular seams in the dark lower fan.

issues.where: air across the basin and behind the animals
issues.what: A nearly even gray-brown veil and a horizontal red fog band mute the depth and heat. The target has more localized, rising orange-lit vapour and clearer separation between the lead animal, the other animals, and the distant rock.

issues.where: cave arch and rock faces adjoining the falls

issues.fix: Carry lava-colored bounce across the underside of the vault and onto the faces near each spill, with clear falloff into the dark stone.

issues.where: left talus and bench immediately beside the cascade
issues.what: Dense angular boulders cover the slope, and the bench has lost the large exposed rock faces and finer talus visible in the native crop of the target.
issues.fix: Use finer scree and occasional embedded stones on the slope, and restore continuous fractured bench faces with warm light on exposed facets.

issues.where: lower runout behind the two animals and air on the right
issues.what: The fume is a broad low brown veil, with weak lift and little luminous orange around the foot of the fall. The target has higher, patchier hot plumes behind the animals and a lighter haze rising into the right side of the basin.

issues.what: The body and legs read nearly unlit, while the tendrils and their contact pool go to a fairly uniform electric orange against gray crust. In the target the warm light picks out bark-like relief, glancing edges and brighter filament tips with a softer spill through the air.
issues.fix: Add selective warm edge and underside bounce, maintain variation in filament brightness, and blend the light from the contact pool into nearby crust and vapour.
